customer_lookup_method: During A-D no other device uses the configured key. Enable the RevenueCat dashboard sandbox-data view and record the dashboard environment and filter. After billing initialization, sort the customer list by Last Seen newest first and identify the unique customer with a last-seen time after that case's launch. Record its exact App User ID and last-seen time in access-controlled evidence. After pm clear and relaunch, allow up to 60 seconds for one unique newest customer; ambiguity is NOT-RUN and BLOCKED.

A.name: offering_and_prices
A.assertion: The plan list shows every recorded che801_test package and its localized Test Store price.
A.customer_entitlement: dashboard state for the identified case customer

B.name: purchase_monthly
B.assertion: The Premium active toast appears in the continuous screen recording, BillingPaywallDemoActivity closes, and premium is active for the identified RevenueCat customer.
B.customer_entitlement: RevenueCat dashboard for the App User ID associated with this purchase

C.name: restore_after_app_data_clear
C.assertion: If the App User ID matches B: the Premium active toast is captured in the continuous screen recording, BillingPaywallDemoActivity closes, and premium remains active for that ID. If the ID differs from B: the required Active restore result is NOT-RUN because the anonymous App User ID changed after pm clear; case C is BLOCKED, never PASS.
C.identity_precondition: Identify the current ID using customer_lookup_method and compare with B; perform Restore for either identity. If no unique current ID is found, mark NOT-RUN and BLOCKED.
C.identity_mismatch_expected: If the ID differs from B: the required Active restore result is NOT-RUN because the anonymous App User ID changed after pm clear; case C is BLOCKED, never PASS.
C.customer_entitlement: Read the current App User ID and B's recorded ID before and after Restore, including whether premium transferred; record the dashboard Restore Behavior setting. On an ID mismatch this evidence is supplementary and cannot make case C pass.

D.name: cancel_purchase
D.assertion: The dialog dismisses, no purchase error appears during the following 30 seconds, the paywall remains open, and premium is inactive for this case's identified customer.
D.customer_entitlement: RevenueCat dashboard for this case's identified App User ID; ambiguous identity is NOT-RUN and BLOCKED

E.name: billing_not_configured
E.assertion: The Billing is not configured message appears and billing initialization is skipped.
E.logcat_expected: absent during the captured startup log window
